name: product-pedestal
keyframe_prompt: Turn this grey blockout into a photorealistic handmade miniature diorama of a tiny town square on a round wooden base on a workbench. The short, wide round drum on the stepped pedestal in the middle is a giant product, a round jar or tin that is wider than it is tall, standing like a monument. Keep its short wide shape. Tiny hand-painted figures look up at it, tiny trees, lamps, benches and little houses around the square. Warm golden-hour light, tilt-shift macro photography, shallow depth of field. Strict composition lock: same high camera angle looking down, same framing and scale as image 1. The whole round base is visible at the bottom of the frame. Do not move, zoom or crop the camera.
keyframe_prompt_photo: Turn the grey blockout in image 1 into a photorealistic handmade miniature diorama of a tiny town square on a round wooden base on a workbench. Replace the tall block on the stepped pedestal with the exact product from image 2, giant like a monument, keeping its shape, colors, materials and label design. Tiny hand-painted figures look up at it, tiny trees, lamps, benches and little houses around the square. Warm golden-hour light, tilt-shift macro photography, shallow depth of field. Strict composition lock: same high camera angle looking down, same framing and scale as image 1. The whole round base is visible at the bottom of the frame. Do not move, zoom or crop the camera.
keyframe_negative: grey clay, untextured, cartoon, low quality, blurry, watermark, deformed
film_prompt: A handmade miniature diorama of a tiny town square on a round wooden base, a giant product standing on a pedestal like a monument, golden-hour light, tiny trees and lamps, tilt-shift macro photography. The miniature figures are frozen in place like painted models and never move; only the camera moves, orbiting down to a low hero angle and pushing in to the product. The light stays soft and even; the doorway and windows glow warmly but are never overexposed or blown out to white.
keyframe_restyle_prompt: Image 1 is a photo of a handmade miniature diorama. Keep image 1 exactly: same camera angle, framing, round wooden base, square, figures, trees and light. Change only the giant short round drum on the pedestal so it becomes the exact product from image 2, at the same giant monument scale: its shape, colors, materials and label design.
reveal_prompt: Realistic close-up smartphone video of this exact product on a table in soft daylight. The camera slowly pushes in. Gentle room tone.
photo_guide: The product alone on a plain surface, the whole product in frame.
